lunch.name: Tacos al Pastor (Mexican Pork Tacos)
lunch.description: Mexican lunch specialty - pork marinated in achiote with pineapple. Blends Mexican and Lebanese influences
instructions: Mix achiote paste, vinegar, orange juice, garlic and cumin in food processor
Rub all over pork slices, marinate 2-4 hours
In cast iron skillet or on vertical rotisserie, cook pork over high heat
Cook 8-10 minutes until charred and cooked through, stirring often
Add pineapple slices to skillet during last 2 minutes
Serve on warmed tortillas with onion and cilantro
Squeeze lime over
lunch.notes: Achiote paste gives distinctive color and flavor. Pineapple adds sweetness balancing spices
lunch.fun_fact: Tacos al Pastor blends Mexican and Lebanese influences, created by Lebanese immigrants in Mexico City in early 20th century

dinner.name: Mexican Mole Negro (Complex Slow-Cooked Dark Mole Sauce)
dinner.description: Complex Oaxacan dark mole sauce - labor-intensive dinner masterpiece
ingredients: 2 tablespoons roasted sesame seeds for garnish
instructions: Remove stems and seeds from dried chiles
Toast chiles briefly in dry skillet (1-2 minutes) until fragrant but not burnt
Soak toasted chiles in hot water 15 minutes; drain, reserve 250ml soaking liquid
Toast almonds, peanuts separately in dry skillet; set aside
Toast sesame seeds, cloves, cinnamon, anise in dry skillet 2-3 minutes
In blender, combine softened chiles, nuts, toasted spices, raisins, garlic, onion, bread, tortillas in batches
Blend until completely smooth, adding reserved chile water gradually
Heat oil in heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat
Pour chile paste through fine strainer into pot, pressing solids through
Cook on medium-low heat 15-20 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning
Paste should darken and thicken; oil will separate at edges
Break chocolate into pieces; add to pot, stir until melted
Add chicken stock; simmer 5 minutes
Season with salt; taste and adjust
Serve over shredded chicken, garnished with toasted sesame seeds
dinner.fun_fact: One of Oaxaca's seven traditional moles
